remarks: Welcome to 32 Hamilton Avenue! Fully updated & carefully curated design throughout! Enter through a custom alderwood front door with fun speakeasy window & into a bright welcoming living room with custom blinds. The living room flows into a large dining space with exposed brick, built in live edge bar & shelving. A sliding glass door opens directly to the backyard oasis with trex deck, privacy fence, hot tub & beautiful mature landscaping. Perfect for entertaining guests! The completely remodeled kitchen features granite countertops, solid wood cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, breakfast bar & one-of-a-kind leather draw pulls & cupboard handles. A beautifully updated convenient half bath off the kitchen. Two good sized first floor bedrooms & thoughtfully updated full bath with low step shower & playful penny floor. Recessed lighting, beautiful fixtures, ceiling fans & high quality vinyl luxury flooring throughout the first floor. Upstairs, the spacious primary bedroom with plush carpeting provides a private retreat, complemented by a comfortable hall sitting area that offers additional space for reading, relaxing or work space. Worry free & convenient living with a pristine concrete driveway (2019), detached 1.5 car garage, classic cedar shaped vinyl siding (2021) & two fresh trex decks with vinyl railings (2021)! Endless updates include full tear off roof & gutters (2019), new hot water tank (2025), brand new Lennox boiler (2026), all windows have been replaced & come with transferable warranty, hot tub (installed 2022, regularly serviced & new heater 2026), chimney rebuilt (2021), updated both baths (2021), glass block (2021) & sliding glass door (2021). Everything has been done for you, all you have to do is move in!
